project_type: Monorepo fullstack app - Python FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, Cloudflare Workers edge proxy
build_system: pnpm workspaces at root, pip for backend, wrangler for edge worker
verification_instructions: Run backend pytest, edge vitest, frontend vitest; check Docker build for backend
setup_instructions: pip install requirements (hash-stripped), pnpm install, set JWT_SECRET and APP_ENV=test
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access; Python 3.11 default; Node 22 available via nvm
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found; code uses ruff for linting, mypy for types
key_patterns: Beanie ODM for MongoDB, httpx async clients with circuit breakers, JWT auth with token blacklisting via Redis, rate limiting via Upstash Redis, SSE streaming for chat, Turnstile bot protection at edge
directory_structure: apps/backend/ (FastAPI Python), apps/frontend/ (React/Vite SPA), apps/edge/ (Cloudflare Worker), infra/ (Azure Bicep + scripts), .github/workflows/ (CI/CD + agent workflows), scripts/ (utility)
